'''Risi e bisi''' (or '''rixi e bixi''') is a Northern Italian dish, a signature meal of the city of Venezia (Venice) in particular, in the Veneto region. Its name literally translates to "rice and peas".

==Ingredients==
* [[Cookbook:Rice|Rice]] (''Vialone Nano'' is prefered)
* [[Cookbook:Pea|Peas]] in their pods

==Procedure==
# Cook the rice per the cooking instructions on the packet.
# [[Cookbook:Boiling|Boil]] the peas with their pods. Mash them.
# Add the mashed peas to the rice.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* [[Cookbook:Bacon|Bacon]] can be added to make it even more delicious.
